name: DS3231 RTC Clock sync with NTP
desc: This example demonstrates how to synchronize a DS3231 RTC module with an NTP server using an ESP32 microcontroller. The current time and temperature are displayed on a 16x2 I2C LCD, and a heartbeat LED blinks every second to indicate the program is running. The RTC is synchronized with the NTP server every hour, and the program handles Wi-Fi connection issues gracefully.
